Container.Name: VynodeIPTV
Container.Overview: Preview release for x86-64 Unraid. Native Shield companion with Xtream providers, guide grids, custom channel groups, independent browser video walls, output health diagnostics and server-side HLS remux or CPU conversion. GPU transcoding not implemented. Read /config/admin.token for first login. Appdata and transcode directories must be writable by UID/GID 10001.

Config.Name: Web and media port
Config.Description: LAN web admin and authenticated media

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Encrypted state and admin token; UID 10001 must have write access

Config.Name: Scratch
Config.Description: Use an existing SSD pool path, writable by UID 10001

Config.Name: Demo channel
Config.Description: Set 1 to enable synthetic signal testing
